top_band: upper lit canopy surface of palm fronds, light-to-mid green (rows 1-11)
evidence: The palm tree shows its upper canopy radiating from a central crown seen from above (rows 1-11) with brighter top highlights at row 5, overhanging and casting shadow onto the segmented brown trunk below (rows 12-40).

style.evidence: While the palette has 5 green and 5 brown steps with dark green/brown outlines, the construction is much more rigid and geometric than the Beodeul reference trees: the trunk is a straight 1px-outlined tube with mechanical horizontal bands and a flat horizontal base cut, rather than organic roots and speckled leaf clusters.
